name: sabnzbd
title: SABnzbd
description: Automated Usenet download client. Drop an NZB file and SABnzbd handles downloading, verifying, repairing, extracting, and filing. Integrates with Sonarr, Radarr, and the full *arr stack.
auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
